notes: The marginal note on Harod and the alternative rendering of the Moreh clause were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
הָיָה לוֹ is divided as preposition plus suffix, the ASV writing *of them* for the pair; the לְ carries the relation and the suffix the pronoun (rules 18, 19).
The article on הַמּוֹרֶה takes the phrase's single written *the*, fronted by English over an anarthrously rendered rectum (rule 29).
